description: A tall bandaged figure looms over the edge of a dark wooden coffin or crate, shown from the waist up, leaning forward to the right with one wrapped arm raised behind it. Its head and body are wound in wide strips of cloth, with two small glowing red eyes in a gaunt, shadowed face. Tall grass or reeds stand at its feet, and a slanted plank of the coffin cuts across the lower right. Behind it is a deep blue night sky. The mood is eerie and stormy. Frame 1: the scene is in dim grey moonlight, the wrappings grey and the sky dark blue. Frame 2: a pale cyan flash of lightning washes over the figure. Frame 3: a jagged yellow bolt strikes the creature's chest, bathing everything in white and brown light under a green sky. The dark grey pose is held long, and the two lightning frames flash by almost instantly, so the loop reads as a long gloom broken by a sudden stab of lightning.
title: Mummy lit by lightning
